# Proportion changes the page {#place}

![Synthetic portrait pattern used to test photo-led placement; not a photograph of a real place.](../../../out/skill-upgrade/gallery-assets/portrait.png)

This deliberately labelled synthetic asset tests portrait-image geometry. A real photo essay would source and review photographs before selecting a composition. Here, the tall image should sit alongside text rather than being forced into a shallow banner.

## A useful visual sequence

The image should have a clear job in the argument. A portrait may establish a human scale or a vertical feature. A panorama may explain the relationship between several parts of a place. Those are different roles, and the page should respond to their proportions.

## Keep the words readable

Captions stay beside their image, and prose stays away from unsafe areas of a photograph. The skill should not solve contrast by dropping a generic dark panel across every image. This fixture uses the same locked theme as the other five documents; its difference must come from placement.
